user.title: Yandex HA Bridge
user.description: Enter a Yandex OAuth token with iot:view permission. To control devices, the token must also have iot:control.

devices.title: Select devices
devices.description: Select Yandex devices to add to Home Assistant. Each selected physical device is registered separately and gets its own entities.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to get devices from Yandex. Check the token and internet connection.

init.title: Yandex HA Bridge devices
init.description: Change the list of devices available to Home Assistant. Selected devices are registered separately in the Device Registry.
